Image's error-state Retry button is ~55px wide inside a 20-40px overflow:hidden thumbnail wrapper on the tiny-size examples, so most of the BUTTON sits outside its container and all of its inset ring's left band does, in a container that can never scroll to reveal it. Surfaced by #526's scroll-extreme tightening. The defect is a control that does not fit its container — a layout change to Image's error state, not a gate change.
